_method: Every fixture is scored twice: once on Copy4Chat output, once on the
control (plain selection.toString(), i.e. an ordinary Ctrl+C).
A fixture the control also passes is not measuring anything and should be
deleted from the suite rather than kept as a comfortable win.
The bar for v0.1 is not prettier output. It is: does the agent get the
relationship right where plain text loses or inverts it?

questions.q: Does Pro include an audit log?
Which feature is available on every plan?

feature-matrix.html.why: Plain text gives an unbound run of ✓/✗ with no row or column binding.

questions.q: What city is this shipping to?

split-labels.html.why: DOM order emits all labels, then all values; pairing is destroyed.

questions.q: Which column is Fix login in?
Reading left to right, what is the order of the columns?

kanban-reordered.html.why: DOM order is Done / To Do / In Progress; plain text is confidently wrong, not merely vague.

questions.q: How many seats does Pro include?
Are these three cards a pricing comparison?
a: one of them is unrelated news

pricing-cards.html.why: Negative test. Output must NOT be a comparison table. Passing by inventing a tidy table is a failure, even if the first question is answered correctly.
